policyNote_one: Automatic versions every {minutes} min when something changed; automatic and safety versions are kept for {count} day. Named versions stay until someone deletes them.
policyNote_other: Automatic versions every {minutes} min when something changed; automatic and safety versions are kept for {count} days. Named versions stay until someone deletes them.
empty: There are no versions of this board yet. Save one now or wait for the first automatic version.
restoredDetail: The previous state was saved as a safety version — and Ctrl+Z undoes it too.
storage.migrated_one: {count} board was moved to the browser's database (IndexedDB), without the 5 MB limit.
storage.migrated_other: {count} boards were moved to the browser's database (IndexedDB), without the 5 MB limit.
storage.migrationFailed_one: {count} board couldn't be migrated and stays in the old storage; nothing was deleted.
storage.migrationFailed_other: {count} boards couldn't be migrated and stay in the old storage; nothing was deleted.

backup.exportText: An .ludraw-workspace file with the organization, policies, people, teams, projects, templates, audit, every board and the version history.
backup.excluded: For safety, passwords and pending invitations aren't included in the backup.
backup.restoreText: Pick an .ludraw-workspace file. The format and version are checked before anything changes.
backup.restoreWarning: This browser's organization, people, teams, projects, templates and audit will be replaced by the backup's. Boards that exist here but aren't in the backup go to the trash. You stay an admin.
backup.errorFormat: This file isn't an LuDraw workspace backup.
backup.errorNewer: This backup uses format version {version}; this installation reads up to version {supported}. Update LuDraw.
backup.errorStructure: The backup is incomplete or corrupted.
backup.errorBoard: The content of the board “{name}” in the backup is corrupted.
backup.errorStorage: There isn't enough browser storage to restore this backup.
storage.blockedDetail: Another LuDraw tab is open on an older version. Close or reload the other tabs to finish; nothing was lost.
storage.versionChanged: LuDraw was updated in another tab. Reload this tab to keep saving safely.
storage.outdated: This tab is from an older version of LuDraw and can't open the updated storage. Reload the page.
storage.fallback: The browser didn't allow IndexedDB: boards are kept in localStorage (about a 5 MB limit).
storage.fallbackDetail: Installed extensions will only last until you close this tab.
